q.note: the query, up to 512 characters. Google's own page (source gg) reads site: and quoted phrases as hints, not filters: check each row's link and text against them

language.note: Google interface language (hl), e.g. en or pt-br; default en

location.note: a city or region, e.g. Austin, TX; an unknown place answers 400 with the closest names

num.note: results to return: a multiple of 10 from 10 to 100 (num/10 Google pages); default 10

page.note: page over num, 1 to 30: num=10&page=2 is results 11-20

source.note: auto (default) may answer from Crawl4AI's fallback page, which has no AI Overview; google answers from Google's own page only, with the AI Overview when Google shows one, and is a free 503 when Google cannot be reached. The answer's source names the page that answered: gg is Google's own, gs the fallback
